scope: Metadata evaluation, parser provenance, test-only executable publication, synthetic fixtures. No real ROM/library/configuration changes, launch policy edits or promotion.

findings.before: Missing parent/ROM source or unknown scan completeness hides observed CRC mismatch as Unknown.
findings.after: Known wrong size/CRC/SHA/CHD identity takes precedence over unresolved dependencies. Absence still needs complete observations and resolved metadata.
findings.tests: Complete, Partial, Unknown and NotGathered observations; split, merged, non-merged and OR alternatives; mixed fresh-subject/stale-support metadata.

findings.before: Correctly identified device ROM in system BIOS archive rejected as DeviceDependencyMissing.
findings.after: Permitted device locations include system, system parents and corresponding BIOS archives. Declaration and owner remain the device; observed archive stays in verified provenance.
findings.negative_tests: Missing device, wrong same-name CRC and correct bytes in unrelated archive remain Incompatible.

findings.before: baddump with empty merge becomes CompatibleWithWarnings; optional baddump with empty merge becomes Compatible.
findings.after: Absent and malformed markers are distinct. Merge-chain validity is checked independently of dump status and before skipping optional bad-dump declarations.
findings.tests: Absent, empty, whitespace, contradictory and valid merge; optional bad dump. Valid bad dumps retain warning classification.

findings.before: Schema-1 ParsedDat drops relationship/default markers yet deserializes into confidently Compatible results even if caller pins schema 1 or 2.
findings.after: Each newly parsed MAME machine carries explicit parser schema 2. Missing stamps deserialize as unknown, never as current. Stale roots fail closed; stale support cannot supply inventories/edges/ownership or prove compatibility. Explicit old pins stay old; misleading current pins are cleared for stale facts.
findings.migration: Retained XML can be reparsed through existing import_mame_listxml and from_imported. The pure supplied-evidence evaluator performs no path IO and otherwise reports StaleMetadata with an explicit reimport instruction. Optional serde field keeps old/non-MAME data readable; no SQL migration or GUI workflow change.
findings.tests: Six actual original-base serialized fixtures, stripped-stamp caches, fresh JSON round trip, explicit version 0/1/2/3, and retained-XML BIOS-default reimport.

findings.before: Independent review intercepted posix_spawnp result 26; controlled sibling fork reproduces the writable-inode race even with close-and-rename publication.
findings.mechanism: An inherited writable descriptor survives in a pre-exec sibling after the test parent closes its copy; FD_CLOEXEC does not close it until exec. Rename preserves the inode and cannot fix this.
findings.after: Only a dedicated child opens the staged stub for writing. Parent sends bytes over a pipe, waits for writer exit, then chmods and renames. Sibling forks cannot inherit a writable executable descriptor from the test parent. The sibling all() assertion now requires an actual probe result.
findings.production: Production discovery/probe code is unchanged and never creates or overwrites emulator binaries. A real missing/unexecutable binary continues to yield unavailable version evidence. No spawn-error suppression, retry loop, global lock or serial-only workaround added.
findings.limitation: The exact descriptor-holder PID in the earlier stochastic review failure was not captured; the controlled failing test proves this fixture lifecycle hazard.

existing_unit_fixture.cause: Synthetic declarations lacked the new parser provenance stamp; explicit current stamps added without changing assertions.

validation.environment: private HOME, XDG_CONFIG/DATA/STATE/CACHE_HOME, TMPDIR and application roots; scripts/cargo-iso --low-debug; offline crates

workspace.warnings: Existing warnings only in unchanged source.

remaining_limitations: Old parsed-only MAME caches require explicit reimport of retained XML; without current facts a confident compatibility verdict is refused.
Evidence remains caller-supplied; no scan of real collections or installed MAME execution was performed.
Mechanical integration analysis is not runtime validation on current main. Review exact correction SHA before replay and revalidate integration.
